notes.subject: ten ples gaden → wanpela bat; homa → efa
notes.rationale: Ol namba bilong skelim: ten akr bilong gaden wain i givim wanpela bat (klostu 22 lita), na homa bilong kaikai pikinini i givim wanpela efa (klostu 1/10 bilong homa) — gaden i bagarap olgeta.

notes.subject: צמדי
notes.rationale: 'Tupela bulmakau i wok wantaim' — tok i min tupela animal i putim long wanpela jok; long hia em i min ples bilong gaden wanpela dei bulmakau i ken wokim.

notes.subject: tasol
notes.rationale: Hibru i no gat 'tasol'; mi putim bilong tok klia olsem wanem olgeta i kamdaun longpela tru — mining i stap long ol namba yet.

translation: Bilong wanem, ten ples bilong tupela bulmakau i wokim gaden wain bai ⟨i⟩ wokim wanpela bat tasol, na kaikai pikinini bilong wanpela homa bai ⟨i⟩ wokim wanpela efa tasol.

tokens.gloss: ples bilong tupela bulmakau i wokim
